tasks.gr6-fossil-fuels-t3: Topic: Fossil fuels and the coal power station. Cover that coal, oil and natural gas formed millions of years ago from dead plants and animals, that coal formed from fossilised plants that got their energy from the Sun, that in South Africa coal is mostly burnt in power stations (coal boils water, steam turns a turbine, the turbine turns a generator), that fossil fuels are non-renewable, and tracing the energy of an appliance back to the Sun. Ask Grade 6 learners to order the steps and name what comes from what.
tasks.gr6-electricity-cost-renewables-t3: Topic: Cost of electricity, saving it, and renewable ways to make it. Cover why electricity is costly (mines, transport, power stations, pylons, substations, wiring), that heating appliances use the most, comparing appliance labels in watts WITHOUT calculating kilowatt hours (a kettle needs more than 2 000 W, a radio about 15 W), saving energy with energy-saving bulbs and solar water heaters, that illegal connections are unsafe, and renewable ways (wind, solar panels, hydro-electric). Ask Grade 6 learners to compare labels and sort renewable from non-renewable.
